name: Consequence of Non-Compliance
title: Consequence of Non-Compliance
text: 7. Failing compliance within the period stated, my client shall be constrained to initiate such civil and criminal proceedings as are available in law, at your risk as to costs and consequences, and without further reference to you. This notice will be relied upon as to costs.

legal_basis.note: Costs of and incident to a suit are in the discretion of the court

authoring_note: The threat must be one the client is prepared to carry out and entitled to make. A threat of criminal proceedings where the dispute is purely civil is improper and can itself found a complaint, so the reference to criminal proceedings should be deleted unless the facts genuinely disclose an offence. The advocate should strike it out where they are not satisfied of that.
